note: Curated multi-word expressions (مركّبات / تعابير) whose meaning is not the sum of their parts. Authoritative, reviewable seed — the build attaches the verses where each occurs. English is a standard, conservative rendering, not a tafsīr; the reader judges sense from the occurrences.

entries.en: the rope of God (His covenant / the Qurʾān)
the Mother of the Book (the foundational scripture / clear verses)
the companions of the right (the blessed)
the companions of the left (the damned)
